title: The Month I Tracked Everything
sentences: Last March I wrote down every single thing I spent money on.
I expected the big costs to be rent and food.
Rent was indeed the largest, but the second largest surprised me.
I had spent nearly two hundred dollars on lunches at work.
None of those lunches had felt like a decision at the time.
That is what made them so easy to ignore.
Since then I have taken food from home three days a week.
I do not enjoy preparing it, and some days I give up.
Even so, I am saving roughly a hundred dollars a month.
The tracking was more useful than any advice I had read.
